nodes.title: AuK — models and setup
widgets_values:
## AuK models

Download one diffusion model, one Qwen encoder and the VAE. Mix precisions if needed. Sizes below are disk GB, not VRAM requirements.

| Model | BF16 | INT8 ConvRot | W4A8 ConvRot |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base | [3.062 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/diffusion_models/auk_base_bf16.safetensors?download=true) | [1.546 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/diffusion_models/auk_base_int8.safetensors?download=true) | [0.880 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/diffusion_models/auk_base_w4a8.safetensors?download=true) |
| Flash | [3.062 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/diffusion_models/auk_flash_bf16.safetensors?download=true) | [1.546 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/diffusion_models/auk_flash_int8.safetensors?download=true) | [0.880 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/diffusion_models/auk_flash_w4a8.safetensors?download=true) |
| Qwen encoder | [8.070 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen_omni_bf16.safetensors?download=true) | [4.669 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen_omni_int8.safetensors?download=true) | [3.179 GB](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen_omni_w4a8.safetensors?download=true) |

[VAE: 0.637 GB, unquantized](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/AuK-comfyui/resolve/main/vae/auk_vae.safetensors?download=true)

## Model folders

```text
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
    ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
    │   └── auk_base_w4a8.safetensors
    ├── 📂 text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen_omni_int8.safetensors
    └── 📂 vae/
        └── auk_vae.safetensors
```

The filenames above are the ones this workflow selects; other formats work, select your installed files in the loaders. Qwen config/tokenizer files are bundled with the node pack; only download weights.

## Settings

- Base: 32 steps, guidance 2, sway -1.
- Flash: fixed four steps, no guidance; ignores those controls.
- Compute precision: auto. Quantization comes from the checkpoint.
- Attention: auto follows ComfyUI; explicit Flash/Sage fall back to SDPA when incompatible or masked.
- Output: mono 24 kHz.
- Reference/source audio plus the generated target share one 30-second budget; trim longer clips first.

[Task guide with examples](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-AuK/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-AuK/issues)

nodes.title: Audio editing and voice cloning
widgets_values:
## Audio editing / voice cloning

1. Upload/select a recording in Load Audio. Its output must connect to Instruction Encode.audio.
2. Replace the instruction with the task you want. This example starts with speech enhancement.
3. seconds=0 preserves source duration. For new spoken text, set the target duration explicitly.

**Enhance**: Preserve all speakers, remove noise and reverberation, and output clean speech of the same length.

**Whisper**: Convert this speech into a soft whisper while preserving the speaker and content. Use seconds=0.

**Clone**: Say the following with the same voice: "The train leaves at nine." Try seconds=3.

**Replace**: Replace 'Tuesday' with 'Friday'. The source must actually say Tuesday.

A connected Instruction Builder STRING overrides the typed instruction. Check the result by listening; edits are not guaranteed.
